scope: Targeted shared-host comparisons, not a new full sparse frontier. Sleeping synthetic evaluator; zero delay except the explicit 50-us regression control. 6D f(x)=x[0], sampler-owned generation and real materialized/feedback transport.
validity: Production frontier warmup and accepted-sample telemetry windows; training must deliver feedback. Queue means deduplicate telemetry publications and exclude the starting endpoint. PostgreSQL wait probes are diagnostic samples, not a wall-time breakdown.
exclusions: Screening ended when run removal hit a cleanup row-lock timeout after trial 15 (zero-based). Its raw interval is retained in development artifacts, but it is excluded from successful trials. Two initial database-affinity probes are excluded; all later probes follow the PostgreSQL daemon. Cleanup joining was fixed before cache, final confirmation and regression tests.
